about: Check-token test vectors from lgtm/docs/plan/02-lab-contract.md. Computed with Python's hmac module (hmac.new(seed.encode(), slot.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:8], and int(that, 16) % 1000000 for metric slots), independently of the site's Web Crypto code. The beacon (card D2) should pass the same vectors.
